# Marilla Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-to-late sixties  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c6 P37](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin woman with angles and no curves, her dark hair showing gray streaks and kept twisted up in a hard little knot behind with two wire hairpins stuck through it. She has a grim, serious expression with a saving hint of humor around her mouth, and her eyes have grown somewhat tired and strained with age.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c30 P0](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0000), [v2 c26 P2](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0002)_

## Personality

Marilla is a woman of narrow experience, rigid conscience, and strict morality, who believes in duty, order, and practical sensible behavior. Though outwardly stern, dryly sarcastic, and undemonstrative, she possesses a deep, unspoken capacity for affection and a quiet sense of humor. She is firmly resolute once her mind is made up, yet capable of mellowing and acknowledging her mistakes over time.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012), [v1 c14 P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v2 c26 P3](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0003)_

- Strict and moralistic  <sub>[v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c8 P41](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0041)</sub>
- Sarcastic and dry-witted  <sub>[v1 c20 P9](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0009), [v2 c27 P23](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To raise Anne into a good, sensible, and useful woman  <sub>[v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>
- To maintain and preserve Green Gables as a home  <sub>[v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P27](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0027)</sub>

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with her quiet brother Matthew, intending to adopt an orphan boy to help on the farm. Through a misunderstanding, an eleven-year-old orphan girl named Anne Shirley was brought to them instead. Though Marilla initially planned to send Anne back, she agreed to keep her at Matthew's urging and took charge of her upbringing. Over the years, Marilla raised Anne with firm discipline, guiding her through school scrapes and growing deeply attached to her. When her eyes began failing and Matthew died suddenly, Anne gave up her college scholarship to stay at Green Gables and teach locally so Marilla would not have to sell the farm. Later, when Anne decided to attend Redmond College after all, Marilla arranged for her widowed neighbor, Mrs. Rachel Lynde, to move into Green Gables so they could keep house together and raise the orphaned Keith twins, Davy and Dora. Marilla welcomed Anne back during college vacations, helped prepare for her wedding to Gilbert Blythe in the Green Gables orchard, and continued living at Green Gables with Mrs. Lynde and the twins.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P12](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0012), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v2 c7 P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v4 c2 P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v2 c26 P2](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0002)</sub>

## Quotes

> I haven't any use at all for little girls who aren't neat.  <sub>[v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001)</sub>

> When I make up my mind to do a thing it stays made up.  <sub>[v1 c9 P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I didn't trouble my head about getting pretty dresses for you. I don't believe in pampering vanity, Anne, I'll tell you that right off.  <sub>[v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008)</sub>

> I believe in a girl being fitted to earn her own living whether she ever has to or not.  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

> I love you as dear as if you were my own flesh and blood and you've been my joy and comfort ever since you came to Green Gables.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
